column companies #1 id integer null=NO default=nextval('platform.companies_id_seq'::regclass)
column companies #2 name character varying(200) null=NO default=-
column companies #3 schema_name character varying(63) null=NO default=-
column companies #4 status character varying(20) null=NO default='active'::character varying
column companies #5 created_at timestamp with time zone null=NO default=now()
column companies #6 migrated_to character varying(255) null=YES default=-
column companies #7 channels_locked boolean null=NO default=false
column companies #8 channels_lock_reason text null=YES default=-
column companies #9 channels_locked_at timestamp with time zone null=YES default=-
column company_logins #1 email character varying(255) null=NO default=-
column company_logins #2 company_id integer null=NO default=-
column company_routes #1 kind character varying(32) null=NO default=-
column company_routes #2 external_id character varying(255) null=NO default=-
column company_routes #3 company_id integer null=NO default=-
column company_routes #4 created_at timestamp with time zone null=NO default=now()
constraint platform.companies companies_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint platform.companies companies_schema_name_key UNIQUE (schema_name)
constraint platform.company_logins company_logins_company_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES platform.companies(id)
constraint platform.company_logins company_logins_pkey PRIMARY KEY (email)
constraint platform.company_routes company_routes_company_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES platform.companies(id)
constraint platform.company_routes company_routes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (kind, external_id)
index CREATE INDEX company_logins_company_idx ON platform.company_logins USING btree (company_id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX companies_pkey ON platform.companies USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX companies_schema_name_key ON platform.companies USING btree (schema_name)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX company_logins_pkey ON platform.company_logins USING btree (email)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX company_routes_pkey ON platform.company_routes USING btree (kind, external_id)
sequence platform.companies_id_seq integer
function c_2.trinity_platform_sync_facebook_page() comment=-
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION c_2.trinity_platform_sync_facebook_page()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
      BEGIN
        IF TG_OP IN ('UPDATE', 'DELETE') THEN
          DELETE FROM platform.company_routes WHERE kind = 'facebook_page' AND external_id = OLD."page_id" AND company_id = 2;
        END IF;
        IF TG_OP IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') THEN
          INSERT INTO platform.company_routes (kind, external_id, company_id) VALUES ('facebook_page', NEW."page_id", 2)
          ON CONFLICT (kind, external_id) DO NOTHING;
          IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.company_routes
                         WHERE kind = 'facebook_page' AND external_id = NEW."page_id" AND company_id = 2) THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'TRINITY_ROUTE_TAKEN: facebook_page % is connected to another company', NEW."page_id";
          END IF;
        END IF;
        RETURN NULL;
      END $function$

function c_2.trinity_platform_sync_login() comment=trinity-sync-v3
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION c_2.trinity_platform_sync_login()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
    BEGIN
      IF TG_OP IN ('UPDATE', 'DELETE') THEN
        DELETE FROM platform.company_logins WHERE email = lower(OLD.email) AND company_id = 2;
      END IF;
      IF TG_OP IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') THEN
        INSERT INTO platform.company_logins (email, company_id) VALUES (lower(NEW.email), 2)
        ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET company_id = EXCLUDED.company_id
          WHERE platform.company_logins.company_id = 2;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.company_logins WHERE email = lower(NEW.email) AND company_id = 2) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'TRINITY_EMAIL_TAKEN: % already belongs to another company', NEW.email;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      RETURN NULL;
    END $function$

function public.trinity_platform_sync_facebook_page() comment=-

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

      BEGIN
        IF TG_OP IN ('UPDATE', 'DELETE') THEN
          DELETE FROM platform.company_routes WHERE kind = 'facebook_page' AND external_id = OLD."page_id" AND company_id = 1;

        IF TG_OP IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') THEN
          INSERT INTO platform.company_routes (kind, external_id, company_id) VALUES ('facebook_page', NEW."page_id", 1)
          ON CONFLICT (kind, external_id) DO NOTHING;

                         WHERE kind = 'facebook_page' AND external_id = NEW."page_id" AND company_id = 1) THEN

function public.trinity_platform_sync_login() comment=trinity-sync-v3
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trinity_platform_sync_login()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
    BEGIN
      IF TG_OP IN ('UPDATE', 'DELETE') THEN
        DELETE FROM platform.company_logins WHERE email = lower(OLD.email) AND company_id = 1;
      END IF;
      IF TG_OP IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE') THEN
        INSERT INTO platform.company_logins (email, company_id) VALUES (lower(NEW.email), 1)
        ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET company_id = EXCLUDED.company_id
          WHERE platform.company_logins.company_id = 1;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform.company_logins WHERE email = lower(NEW.email) AND company_id = 1) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'TRINITY_EMAIL_TAKEN: % already belongs to another company', NEW.email;
        END IF;
      END IF;
      RETURN NULL;
    END $function$

trigger CREATE TRIGGER trinity_platform_sync_facebook_page AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF page_id ON c_2.facebook_pages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION c_2.trinity_platform_sync_facebook_page()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER trinity_platform_sync_facebook_page AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF page_id ON public.facebook_pages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.trinity_platform_sync_facebook_page()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER trinity_platform_sync_login AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF email ON c_2.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION c_2.trinity_platform_sync_login()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER trinity_platform_sync_login AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF email ON public.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.trinity_platform_sync_login()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER trinity_platform_sync_zalo_oa AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF oa_id ON c_2.zalo_oa_connections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION c_2.trinity_platform_sync_zalo_oa()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER trinity_platform_sync_zalo_oa AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF oa_id ON public.zalo_oa_connections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.trinity_platform_sync_zalo_oa()
